narr: Two organized lines of thunderstorms moved into eastern Oklahoma during the morning of the 10th, one from the southwest and one from the northwest. The strongest thunderstorms produced damaging wind. Locally heavy rainfall also occurred in some locations, with a swath of three to six inches falling across Muskogee, Sequoyah, and northern Le Flore Counties, which subsequently resulted in some flash flooding.
ev: W Broadway Street was flooded with several feet of water near N 51st Street.
Portions of several roads were flooded on the west side of Sallisaw.
Portions of a number of roads were flooded across the county.
